goal: Find a tactical line with ordered basic chess predicates

controller_notes: predicate.js is the unmodified historical v1.1.0 controller.
26 chess cards compile to inspect/search states; mechanical stack states are separate.
Every pop re-reads current board facts. No hidden sticky plan or learned classifier.
All matching candidates are queued in predicate order before the next pop; no candidate cap.
Own choices are OR; every selected opponent reply is an AND obligation.
Empty reply selection is unresolved unless a shared stopping rule already applied.
Generic inspection depth8 permits proof propagation at ply7; the Oracle constructs no ply8.
The page enforces100 examined positions independently of the state-visit safety budget.
